# Alpha 78 Logistics Center

<!-- Generated by examples/woodmont-portfolio/build.ts from alpha-78/facts.json. Edit the JSON and rebuild. -->

**Type:** Class A cross-dock logistics building (industrial)  
**Location:** 5 Edge Road, Alpha, Warren County, NJ: directly off Route 22, adjacent to I-78

A 450,457 SF cross-docked warehouse on a 33.67-acre site, developed by Woodmont Industrial Partners with Brookfield Properties: 36-foot clear, 118 dock doors, four drive-ins, a 130-foot truck court, 89 trailer and 230 car spaces.

## Estimates

Each of these is a modelling assumption, not a published number.

| Assumption | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Building depth | 400 ft | **Estimate.** Not published. 400 ft is within the usual 360-420 ft range for a cross-dock building of this size. |
| Building length | 1126 ft | **Estimate.** 450,457 SF / the estimated 400 ft depth = 1,126 ft; it moves with the depth estimate. |
| Wall height above the warehouse floor | 12.5 m | **Estimate.** 41 ft: the published 36 ft clear plus about 5 ft of roof structure. |
| Dock-high floor above the truck courts | 1.22 m | **Estimate.** 48 in, the usual dock height; ramps to the drive-in doors are not modelled. |
| Docks and drive-ins per side | 59 docks and 2 drive-ins on each long side | **Estimate.** A cross-dock is usually symmetric; the published totals (118 and 4) are split evenly. |
| Dock door size | 9 x 10 ft | **Estimate.** Common dock door size; not published. |
| Drive-in door size | 12 x 14 ft | **Estimate.** Common drive-in size; not published. |
| Dock door spacing | 14 ft | **Estimate.** Centre-to-centre; each side's run is centred on its wall. |
| Trailer stall size | 12 x 55 ft | **Estimate.** Typical; the 89 stalls are split 45 / 44 in one row past each truck court. |
| Car parking layout | 9 x 18 ft stalls on 24 ft aisles, split between the two short ends | **Estimate.** Position and layout are estimates; the count is published. |
| Office position | middle of the plan-west end wall, one story | **Estimate.** Not published; drawn as a one-story room about 1.6:1 in plan, in the middle of the west end wall, so both dock walls stay clear. |
| Site outline | rectangle of the published 33.67 acres, the building centred | **Estimate.** No parcel geometry or aerial image was reachable from the build environment, so the outline, the building's position on it and its orientation are schematic. The rectangle leaves at least 30 m around the modelled layout (building, courts, trailer rows, car fields); areas and counts are the published ones. |
| Exterior wall thickness | 0.3 m | **Estimate.** Tilt-up concrete panels are typically 9-12 in; not published. |

## Conflicts and notes

- ROI-NJ and Real Estate NJ (August 2024, at announcement) gave 6,000 SF of office; the current CBRE leasing site lists a 3,000 SF spec office. The leasing site is used.
- ROI-NJ said completion was expected in the third quarter of 2025; Woodmont's site says the building "is available for immediate occupancy."
- Woodmont's site rounds the building to 450,000 SF; CBRE gives 450,457 SF, which is used.
